paragraphs.text: Mount Oremon (OR-ray-mon ) was the highest mountain in the Scarlet domain of Ephren . It is said to contain massive amounts of red mana and to be the home of the Ash Warlords . One of them was the planeswalker Embereck . According to Jeff Gòmez, editor of the Armada comics , the Ash Warlords emerged from "within Dominaria" through Oremon. Based on the appearance of Embereck, the Ash Warlords were a race of fire elementals .
